list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Praseodymium mono(1,2,4-triphenylcyclopentadienyl) chloride ate complex, toluene tetrasolvate

material_class.structural_family: Tetranuclear mono(triphenylcyclopentadienyl) lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Two equivalent units, each containing two Pr centers and one K center linked by bridging chlorides, join through two K–Cl bonds. Each Pr binds four bridging chlorides, one THF oxygen, and one η5-triphenylcyclopentadienyl ligand; K also contacts a ligand phenyl group.

synthesis.procedure: Under prepurified argon, benzyl potassium in THF was added slowly to 1,2,4-triphenylcyclopentadiene in THF and stirred for 15 min. The resulting triphenylcyclopentadienyl potassium solution was added slowly to a stirred suspension of PrCl3(THF)2 in THF and stirred for 12 h.
synthesis.time: 15 min ligand formation; 12 h after addition to PrCl3(THF)2; 10 days crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: SPEKS-GB2 glove box; stirred reaction under prepurified argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Centrifuged to remove precipitated KCl; washed the precipitate with THF (5 mL), centrifuged again, combined supernatants, and evaporated to dryness. Dissolved the oil in toluene (15 mL), carefully layered hexane (20 mL), and collected crystals after 10 days; dried under dynamic vacuum. X-ray-quality crystals were obtained by slow hexane diffusion into a toluene solution; the crystal contained four toluene molecules, two of which were lost during vacuum drying.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Praseodymium bis(1,2,4-triphenylcyclopentadienyl) chloride–potassium chloride ate complex

material_class.structural_family: Binuclear bis(triphenylcyclopentadienyl) lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

source_locations.location: Experimental, synthesis of II and shared procedure for I

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete binuclear ate complex with a [Pr(μ-Cl)2K]2 core. Each Pr is coordinated by two η5-triphenylcyclopentadienyl ligands and two chloride ligands; the K ions lack an O- or N-donor ligand.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared under prepurified argon by a procedure similar to that for I, using benzyl potassium to generate triphenylcyclopentadienyl potassium from 1,2,4-triphenylcyclopentadiene in THF, then reacting it with PrCl3(THF)2. The stated starting-material ratio differs from that for I.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: SPEKS-GB2 glove box; procedure similar to I under prepurified argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The article refers to the procedure for I but does not separately specify the workup or crystallization conditions for II.

material_class.structural_family: Tetranuclear mono(triphenylcyclopentadienyl) lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

source_locations.location: Experimental, synthesis of III and shared procedure for I; Results and Discussion

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A tetranuclear Er–K chloride ate complex structurally similar to I, comprising two chloride-linked Er2K units. Unlike I, each potassium ion is coordinated by five chloride ligands and a THF molecule.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared under prepurified argon by a procedure similar to that for I: benzyl potassium and 1,2,4-triphenylcyclopentadiene generate the cyclopentadienyl potassium reagent in THF, which is reacted with ErCl3(THF)3.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: SPEKS-GB2 glove box; procedure similar to I under prepurified argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Isolated by recrystallization from a THF–hexane mixture. X-ray-quality crystals were obtained by slow diffusion of hexane into a THF solution of III.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Erbium bis(1,2,4-triphenylcyclopentadienyl) chloride–potassium chloride ate complex

material_class.structural_family: Binuclear bis(triphenylcyclopentadienyl) lanthanide–potassium chloride ate complex

source_locations.location: Experimental, synthesis of IV and shared procedure for I

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete binuclear ate complex with a [Er(μ-Cl)2K]2 core, isostructural to the praseodymium bis-cyclopentadienyl complex II.

synthesis.procedure: Prepared under prepurified argon by a procedure similar to that for I, starting with benzyl potassium, 1,2,4-triphenylcyclopentadiene, and erbium chloride tetrahydrofuranate. Following reaction and centrifugation, the resulting oil was evaporated and worked up as specified for IV.
synthesis.time: 10 days for the first crystal crop
synthesis.vessel_or_method: SPEKS-GB2 glove box; procedure similar to I under prepurified argon
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Washed the oil with toluene (10 mL), separated the pink precipitate by centrifugation, dissolved it in THF (15 mL), and carefully layered hexane (20 mL). Collected pink crystals after 10 days and dried them under vacuum. Added a further 20 mL of hexane to the mother liquor for a second crop. X-ray-quality crystals were obtained by slow hexane diffusion into a THF solution.
